run_hydra_app: run the hydra app that prints a config with an optional list of integers
create_config_dataclass: create a dataclass Config with an optional list of integers field for hydra
store_config_in_configstore: store a dataclass config node in the hydra ConfigStore with a name
run_main_with_dictconfig: run the main function that accepts a DictConfig and prints it
review_Config_class: review the Config dataclass that defines an optional list of integers for hydra
